EYEBROW: Canoga Park · Tires, wheels and repair
SERVICE_HEADLINE: Tires, wheels, and the repairs most tire shops send away
TAGLINE: A tire shop that is also a workshop: alignment, TPMS and wheel work alongside brakes, A/C and engine repair. Fleet accounts and vehicle pick-up available.
SERVICES_INTRO: The 'and more' is the point: one stop for the tires and for whatever the alignment check turns up.
SERVICE_1_BODY: Fitting, balancing, rotation, flat repair, TPMS programming, and wheel repair or refinishing.
SERVICE_2_BODY: Alignment, wheel bearings and the components that were quietly eating your last set of tires.
SERVICE_3_BODY: Brakes, battery, A/C, engine and transmission work, plus factory scheduled maintenance.
WHY_INTRO: There are other shops within a few minutes of here. This is what a customer actually notices.
WHY_1_BODY: The quote comes before the work, and nothing gets done without you agreeing to it.
WHY_2_BODY: A person picks up during opening hours, and a missed call gets returned the same day.
WHY_3_BODY: Whatever came off the car is there to look at if you want to see it.
CONTACT_INTRO: Call for anything urgent. For a quote or a booking the form reaches the desk directly.
ABOUT_BODY: More than a tire shop: alignment, TPMS and wheel work alongside brakes, A/C, engine and transmission repair. Fleet accounts are welcome, and vehicle pick-up and delivery is available.
